data.description:
## Story

As a sprint sub-agent implementing a story that has a `## Closure Checks` section, the implementation-plan DD partitioning step only assigns items from `## Done Definitions` (or `## Success Criteria` at the task level) to tasks — Closure Checks items are NOT partitioned into task assignments, because they are end-state intent verified at closure time, not implementation work items.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md` updated at the DD partitioning step — explicit guard: "Items under `## Closure Checks` are excluded from the DD partition. Only done definitions and success criteria from `## Done Definitions` / `## Success Criteria` sections are assigned to tasks."
- DD2: Test (behavioral): a story ticket with 3 done definitions and 2 Closure Checks items produces tasks whose Story DD Coverage sections reference only the 3 done definitions — no Closure Checks items appear in any task's coverage section
- DD3: Note added inline in the implementation-plan SKILL.md partition step explaining why: "Closure Checks are verified at story/epic closure by the completion-verifier agent; they are not implementation targets."

← Satisfies: "SC (adversarial F12): implementation-plan DD partitioning correctly excludes Closure Checks"

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
data.title: Implementation-plan DD partitioning excludes Closure Checks items so they are not assigned to implementation tasks
